mapper.sql: id, chart_id, chart_account_id, change_type, before_account_no, after_account_no, before_parent_account_id, after_parent_account_id, before_account_name, after_account_name, before_account_status, after_account_status, operator_id, change_time
mapper.select: SELECT h.id change_id, h.chart_account_id, h.change_type, h.before_account_no, h.after_account_no, bp.account_no before_parent_account_no, ap.account_no after_parent_account_no, h.before_account_name, h.after_account_name, h.before_account_status, h.after_account_status, h.operator_id, h.change_time FROM t_chart_account_change h LEFT JOIN t_chart_account bp ON bp.id = h.before_parent_account_id LEFT JOIN t_chart_account ap ON ap.id = h.after_parent_account_id WHERE h.chart_id = #{chartId} AND h.chart_account_id = #{chartAccountId} ORDER BY h.change_time DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
